title: A Bucket Full of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Persistent state graph for the Senait Sisters movie-lot mission. Side jobs, dirty-deed choices, mechanical checks, climax consequences and filming eligibility remain deterministic and player-owned.
premise: A Fixer scores the Crew an audition as extras in the Senait Sisters' Addiswood historical romance The Parisian Hostess. The gig opens doors to catering, effects work, celebrity favors and dangerous tabloid attention.
publicBackground: The Crew has a legitimate audition invite for an Addiswood production shooting in Night City.
gmBackground: The mission is a web of legitimate movie work and optional ethically dubious side offers. The engine must preserve whether the Crew steals a serialized script and/or bugs Etan Sim, because those choices alter the final filming outcome.

gmGuidance: Do not force a single path through the side jobs.
Script theft and bug planting are explicit player choices and must never be auto-selected.
Rules Engine owns all DV checks and the final 1d10 screen-appearance roll.
If both script theft and bug planting occur, persist the authored consequence: contracts are void and the Crew is removed from filming.
If only one or neither dirty deed occurs, the Crew remains eligible for the two filming days.
Malarkey does not automatically pay for the bug job; preserve that consequence.
Creative non-combat resolutions at Lovely House are valid and preferred over forced violence.
